detail: A navigation projection selected any string key containing id, exposing candidate_disposition and candidate_AREG_overlay_records_role before the first judgment. Candidate source reasoning was not shown, but the pointer-only deferral was violated.

Initial complete streams used find-renames rather than required no-renames. Both were later reacquired with all required flags and identical full bytes/SHA256. No renamed path existed; initial flag deviation remains recorded.

Initial git status --short inspected the worktree/index before the object-only workflow. No prior index checksum exists and no index/ref byte attestation is made. No explicit Git mutation command was issued.

A candidate Markdown report was mistakenly invoked through Python from the worktree. Compilation failed at line3 before statements executed. It was then read correctly from exact ACT Git objects. No historical verifier or reference program ran.

Initial row regex omitted nonlisted catalog prefixes; corrected to every ID row. Fixed external controls were initially resolved against ACT, then correctly against ORIGINAL/PLAN. Locator records were initially treated as a list, then as the actual dictionary. A protected-header ASCII-colon guess and an unmatched-parenthesis check failed before output publication and were corrected. No such failed diagnostic is an ACT defect.

Own generated report references initially inherited absolute helper-directory paths. Privacy QA detected them; only own findings/input identity publication paths were corrected to logical repository paths before handoff. No frozen input or first judgment was changed.
